-- A bounded human/agent query for the newly added endpoint.
SELECT r.logical_path, d.symbol.entity_name, d.symbol.symbol_kind,
 d.symbol.line_start, d.symbol.line_end, d.symbol.byte_start, d.symbol.byte_end
FROM real_review r, UNNEST(r.result.changes) AS u(d)
WHERE r.logical_path='app_gallery/code-graph-workbench/server/tools/query.py'
ORDER BY d.symbol.line_start;
